            # Print rows

                print("|".join(str(item) for item in row))
        else:
            # For non-SELECT queries, print success message
            print("Query executed successfully")
        
        # Close connections
        cur.close()
        conn.close()
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
